timing: $50 deposited into both the referrer's and new member's savings accounts within 5 business days of account opening, per the official terms.
who_pays: Space Age Credit Union pays the bonus — $50 deposited directly into your Space Age savings account and $50 into your friend's. That's real money, not a gift card.
who_qualifies: You must already be a Space Age member. Your friend must be 18+, never a previous Space Age member, and either live, work, worship, or attend school in one of 10 Colorado counties (Adams, Arapahoe, Boulder, Broomfield, Denver, Douglas, El Paso, Jefferson, Larimer, Weld) or work for a partner company.
work_available: The referral program is live on Space Age's official site with no published end date — but the terms say they can end the promotion at any time. You're capped at 5 referral payouts per year.
what_gets_accepted: Your friend must open a savings account PLUS one more product — a checking account with a debit card, a Space Age credit card, or any loan. Savings alone earns nothing. They also have to give your name plus your email or address during the welcome call, because there are no retroactive claims if they forget.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to participate. The unpaid work is getting a Colorado friend to open two accounts at once — a real ask — plus making sure they name you on the welcome call, since forgetting means the referral pays nobody.
when_cash_arrives: The $50 is deposited into both of your Space Age savings accounts within 5 business days of the account opening.
